texts.en:
The Voidlure we had previously developed attracted a group of space whales native to systems with Gas Giants akin to [This.Capital.System.GetName].

It seems our devices must be built in those environments to work properly. Should we discover other wild fauna, we should be able to construct Voidlures near their natural habitats as well.

summary.text:
# 鲸歌 / Whalesong

- 分类 Category：银河轶事 C8 stories · DLC：Grand Archive

## 如何开始 How it starts

on_first_contact_finished（common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:777）触发隐藏的首次接触事件 grand_archive.7015（events/grand_archive_events.txt:7030-7054）：若联络对象是缇扬奇国家，且本国带有“虚空诱饵吸引了缇扬奇”标记（voidlure_attracted_tiyanki，由 7055 / 虚空诱饵设置）。5 天后给出 7020。
After a first contact, if the Tiyanki were attracted by our Voidlure, 7020 follows five days later.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

7020 “鲸歌”：虚空诱饵的成功通知；唯一选项“很好”。
7020: a success notice for the Voidlure; single option.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 无分支。

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 原始召唤起源与游牧版有各自的前置事件（7050 / 7055 在游牧原始召唤开局赠送的缇扬奇）。 The nomadic Primal Calling start spawns a free Tiyanki through 7050/7055.
